---
title: 'How does WhatsApp Commerce work?'
description: 'Connect WhatsApp in the dashboard, share payment links in chat, and send transactional notifications when configured.'
---

WhatsApp Commerce on lomi. combines **payment links**, **hosted checkout**, and optional **WhatsApp channel** setup in the merchant dashboard. It is built for merchants who already sell through WhatsApp, Instagram, and SMS in francophone West Africa.

## Connect WhatsApp in the dashboard

1. Open **Settings → Channels → WhatsApp** in the [dashboard](https://dashboard.lomi.africa).
2. Complete embedded signup to connect your business number through Kapso.
3. Use WhatsApp for **transactional template notifications** (payment receipts, renewal reminders) where enabled on your account. lomi. does not expose free-form WhatsApp messaging through the merchant API.

## Collect payment in chat

- Create a [payment link](/build/payment-links) from the dashboard or API and paste the URL in WhatsApp.
- Customers pay on **lomi. Checkout** with Wave, MTN MoMo, cards, and other methods enabled for your organization.
- Store `whatsapp_number` on [customers](/api/customers) for checkout prefill and operational follow-up.

## Related integrations

- [Relay](https://lomi.africa/relay) on lomi.africa covers store plugins plus social selling in one story.
- [Payment links](/build/payment-links) for no-code sales without a website.
- [Hosted checkout](/build/checkout) when your backend creates checkout sessions for every order.

## Webhooks and fulfillment

Confirm payment with webhooks and `GET /transactions/{id}` before you ship goods or grant access. See [Verify payments](/build/guides/verify-payments).
